name: Bimbobilier
source:
Step into the shoes of Kevin Crook (name customizable), who runs the Bimbobilier Real Estate agency.

Kevin rigs the rooms he rents out with equipment to hypnotize tenants.
Hilarity ensues.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/bimbobilier-v0-3-1-xcentric-labs.120641/]F95Zone[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演經營Bimbobilier房屋仲介公司的凱文．克魯克（名字可以更改）。

凱文在出租房裡偷偷裝上能催眠房客的裝置。
一連串鬧劇由此展開。
